name: deepbom
description: Inspect serialized AI deployment artifacts and report hash-bound static evidence, limitations, and reproducible checks.

interface.longDescription: Inspect supported AI deployment artifacts without executing model code. Results bind observations to the artifact hash and keep defects, cautions, evidence gaps, and static-analysis limits separate.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this ONNX file's quantization evidence.
List the tensor encodings in this GGUF artifact.
Explain what changed between these model artifacts.
